Imagine you have a super smart robot that can do lots of things, like play games or write stories. But, even the people who made this robot, they don't fully understand how it works, kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?)

It's like building a really complex Lego castle, but you don't know how the individual Lego pieces fit together, wa kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?). You can make the castle look really cool, but you don't know the secret behind it, ogenki desu ka? (how are you?).

Large neural networks and AIs like ChatGPT or Midjourney are like those Lego castles. They're made up of many tiny pieces, like neurons and weights, that work together to make the robot do things. But, the people who made them, they don't fully understand how those tiny pieces fit together, wa kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?).

It's not that they didn't try to understand, but it's like trying to solve a really hard math problem, nan desu ka? (what is this?). The math is so complex that even the smartest people in the world can't fully understand it, ogenki desu ka? (how are you?).

So, even though the creators of these robots are really smart, they don't fully understand how they work, wa kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?). But, that's okay, because they can still make really cool things with them, nan desu ka? (what is this?).
